environment.description: Rails 7.1 application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an AWS ALB with TLS termination. The ALB forwards all HTTP headers to the application. No request rate limiting is configured. Internal gRPC services trust the 'authorization' metadata field from the API gateway without additional validation of the metadata origin. The internal network allows direct gRPC communication between the gateway and all backend services.

config.network: VPC with permissive security groups between services
